name: Habshan Gas Processing Complex
description: The largest onshore gas processing complex in the country, taking gas from the Bab field and its neighbours.

name: Habshan 5 Gas Plant
description: Processes offshore gas brought ashore under the integrated gas development.

name: Bab Gas Plant
description: Compresses and processes the associated gas of the Bab field.

name: Asab Gas Plant
description: Processes the associated gas of the Asab field in the south-east of Al Dhafra.

name: Bu Hasa Gas Plant
description: Processes the associated gas of the Bu Hasa field.

name: Ruwais NGL Fractionation Plant
description: Splits the natural gas liquids from the gas plants into ethane, propane, butane and naphtha.

name: Das Island LNG Plant
description: Liquefies offshore gas for export by ship from Das Island.

name: Shah Gas Plant
description: Processes very sour gas from the Shah field and recovers its sulphur.

name: Bu Hasa Field Facilities
description: Oil production and processing facilities of the Bu Hasa field.

name: Jebel Dhanna Terminal
description: Crude oil storage and export terminal on the Al Dhafra coast.

name: Fujairah Oil Terminal
description: Crude oil export terminal on the Gulf of Oman, at the end of the pipeline from Habshan.

name: Zirku Island Facilities
description: Offshore crude oil processing, storage and export facilities on Zirku Island.

name: Upper Zakum Facilities
description: Production facilities of the Upper Zakum offshore field.

name: Ruwais Refinery
description: Crude oil refining complex in the Ruwais industrial city.

name: Borouge Petrochemical Complex
description: Polyolefins complex producing polyethylene and polypropylene from ethane.

name: Ruwais Fertilizer Plant
description: Ammonia and urea production plant in the Ruwais industrial city.
